answer: Pay bounties to sybil hunters: anyone may stake a small bond and submit proof that a cluster of identities is one operator; if peers confirm, the fakes are burned and the hunter takes their deposits, so a farm must survive a crowd of paid watchers. A single whisper of duplicated behaviour can trigger a probe, and the delta between honest and fake activity grows under scrutiny, while a lone sable account hiding in the herd still risks exposure. Limits: hunters may frame honest users, so false claims must lose their bond.
